article_title: Fatima El Mansouri: What can Morocco's first female prime minister change for women?

tasks.prompt: What central question does the article explore?
options: Whether El Mansouri's historic appointment can produce meaningful change for women within Morocco's political and religious constraints
Whether Morocco will immediately replace its monarchy with a republic
How El Mansouri plans to move the capital from Rabat to Marrakech
Why every party refused to join El Mansouri's coalition
tasks.correct_answer: Whether El Mansouri's historic appointment can produce meaningful change for women within Morocco's political and religious constraints
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת אם המינוי ההיסטורי יתורגם לשינוי ממשי לנשים, לנוכח כוחו של המלך, התנגדות דתית ומגבלות פוליטיות.

tasks.prompt: What parliamentary position does El Mansouri's coalition hold?
options: It has exactly half of the seats.
It holds 207 of the 395 seats.
It has no elected seats and depends only on royal appointment.
It controls all 395 seats.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מפלגת Pam הקימה קואליציה עם שלוש מפלגות נוספות, וביחד יש להן 207 מתוך 395 מושבים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “room for manoeuvre” mean?
options: The size of the prime minister's official residence
The number of rooms available in parliament
Her freedom and practical ability to take political action
Her authority to replace religious scholars
tasks.correct_answer: Her freedom and practical ability to take political action
tasks.explanation_hebrew: room for manoeuvre מתאר את מרחב הפעולה המעשי שלה, המוגבל בשל חלוקת הסמכויות עם המלך והצורך להתמודד עם מוסדות דתיים.

tasks.prompt: Which statistic illustrates the rural-urban education gap for girls aged 15–17 in 2025?
options: School attendance was 38% in rural areas and 55% in cities.
It was 100% in both rural and urban areas.
It was 55% in cities and 100% in rural areas.
It was 55% in rural areas and 100% in urban areas.
tasks.correct_answer: It was 55% in rural areas and 100% in urban areas.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נציבות התכנון מצאה שרק 55% מהנערות בגילים אלה למדו באזורים כפריים, לעומת 100% באזורים עירוניים.

tasks.prompt: Why does Fernandez-Molina connect the appointment with low election turnout?
options: She argues the symbolic appointment may help the monarchy project modernisation and reinforce legitimacy despite weak participation.
She believes turnout was low because women were legally barred from voting.
She says the appointment automatically transfers the king's powers to parliament.
She claims the election results were cancelled after the appointment.
tasks.correct_answer: She argues the symbolic appointment may help the monarchy project modernisation and reinforce legitimacy despite weak participation.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוקרת מפרשת את המינוי כמהלך מלמעלה שמציג קדמה ושוויון ועשוי לחזק לגיטימציה של המשטר בתקופה של השתתפות נמוכה.

tasks.prompt: What does “instrumentalisation” mean in the phrase “selective instrumentalisation of the struggle for women's rights”?
options: Measuring public opinion with scientific instruments
Giving activists complete control over policy
Using a cause as a tool to achieve another political purpose
Removing women's rights from public debate
tasks.correct_answer: Using a cause as a tool to achieve another political purpose
tasks.explanation_hebrew: instrumentalisation פירושה שימוש במאבק כאמצעי להשגת מטרה אחרת; כאן מדובר בשימוש סלקטיבי בזכויות נשים לצורכי לגיטימציה של המשטר.

tasks.prompt: Identify three family-law issues discussed as tests for the new government.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה נושאים קונקרטיים מתוך הדיון במודוואנה, כגון ירושה, taasib, פוליגמיה, נישואין, גירושין או משמורת.
expected_points: Unequal inheritance rules, under which a daughter typically receives half a son's comparable share.
The taasib rule that may require female orphans without brothers to share inheritance with male relatives.
Conditions and proposed restrictions concerning polygamy.
Broader reform of marriage, divorce and child-custody rules in the Moudawana.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence the article gives both for and against viewing El Mansouri's appointment as progress for women.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג באופן מאוזן את פריצת המחסום והייצוג הסמלי לצד המגבלות המבניות, הרקע הפריבילגי והיעדר עמדה ציבורית בולטת על זכויות נשים.
expected_points: She is Morocco's first female prime minister and her appointment breaks a longstanding barrier.
Her coalition has a parliamentary majority, and many younger Moroccans welcomed the milestone.
The king retains extensive powers and religious scholars can constrain family-law reform.
El Mansouri has not made prominent public statements on women's rights, and critics note her privileged access to political networks.

tasks.prompt: Why do some women quoted in the article judge El Mansouri by policy rather than by her gender alone?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שייצוג סמלי אינו מבטיח שינוי, ולקשר זאת לרפורמות הממתינות, לפערי החינוך ולמגבלות על זכויות נשים.
expected_points: A woman in office does not automatically support or deliver women's-rights reforms.
The announced family-code reforms have not yet become law.
Concrete outcomes on inheritance, polygamy, education and menstrual health matter more than symbolism alone.
Her party's modernising image will be tested by actual policy.

tasks.prompt: Write a short analytical paragraph using the words “milestone”, “constraints” and “legitimacy”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בשלוש המילים במדויק, להבחין בין משמעות סמלית לשינוי מוסדי ולהציג טענה הנתמכת בפרטים מהכתבה.
expected_points: Use all three required words accurately.
Describe the appointment as a historic milestone.
Explain the constitutional, royal or religious constraints on the prime minister.
Discuss the argument that the appointment may strengthen regime legitimacy without guaranteeing reform.
